P3,enriched,combination,"[8,5]",M0 measurable-claim requirement (metric + baseline + threshold),qwen2.5-coder-14b-local,qwen2.5-coder:14b,ollama,off,"### Part 1: Candidate Mission Statements

NC State Dining is a maze of options with no clear path for students with dietary restrictions. PackPlate consolidates hours, menus, and nutrition into one accessible dashboard. Users can filter by allergies, halal, vegetarian, and protein targets. When dining with friends, the app suggests shared locations based on availability and crowd levels. This reduces the time a group of three with different diets needs to agree on a dining hall from 30 minutes to under 10. The unique feature of crowd levels, updated by students, gives an accurate reflection of the current situation in each dining hall.

Navigating NC State’s dining options can be a daunting task, especially for students with dietary needs. PackPlate brings hours, menus, and nutrition information into one convenient platform. Users can easily filter meals by allergies, halal, vegetarian, and target protein content. Additionally, the app can determine the best location for a group of friends based on multiple dietary restrictions. This reduces the time a group of three with different diets needs to decide on a dining hall from 30 minutes to under 10. The explicit flags for incomplete data ensure users are aware of any discrepancies between published information and real-life experiences.

Students at NC State often struggle to find a dining option that suits their dietary needs and accommodates their friends. PackPlate offers a comprehensive view of hours, menus, and nutrition for every dining hall on campus. Users can filter options by allergies, halal, vegetarian, and protein targets, and the app can suggest locations for a group of friends based on their individual dietary needs. This reduces the time a group of three with different diets needs to agree on a dining hall from 30 minutes to under 10. By integrating real-time crowd levels reported by students, PackPlate provides a more accurate picture of the current situation in each dining hall, helping users make better decisions.
